verdict_text: NO. The merge arithmetic is wrong: the second task vector is taken against `tmp` (the base already modified by the first merge) rather than the unmodified base, computing `tmp + 0.4*(ft2 - tmp)` instead of `base + 0.4*(ft1 - base) + 0.4*(ft2 - base)`. This violates Required result step 2 and is exactly the ordering hazard the Objective warns against. The two expressions differ by `0.16*(ft1 - base)`, which will exceed the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance wherever ft1 changed a tensor.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
